name: Media Bar
description: Adds a media bar element at the top of the homepage on Jellyfin web (CarlSntg fork: admin-enforced config for the per-user settings panel)

versions.changelog: Fix the plugin configuration page not initialising after 3.0.1.0. A Version string equal to the installed plugin version now uses the embedded frontend.

Admin-enforced config: all per-user settings panel options are now configurable from the Dashboard, with 'Enforce these settings for all users' and 'Hide the user settings button'. Fixes MaxTvShows mapping.
